verdict.rationale: Browserbase Agents documentation says agents can process downloaded content such as PDFs and spreadsheets, and those files can be retrieved through the Downloads API. This is a thin, glancing mention of hosted document handling. Text extraction quality is not described. missing for 10: explicit text-extraction capability and output format, Word and PowerPoint support, documentation of extraction quality and fidelity, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can extract text content from PDFs, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files without hosting them myself

citations.quote: Process downloaded content such as PDFs and spreadsheets.
Retrieve it with the Downloads API using the sessionId from the run.
